document.title: Terrorism: Usama bin Ladin's Historical Links to Abdullah Azzam
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Central Intelligence Agency 9/11 File: Hundreds of Secret Agency Documents on Osama Bin Laden Declassified
document.note: CIA Intelligence Report on bin Ladin's historical links to Abdullah Azzam. Source: 9/11 Commission Report, Chapter 4, Endnotes 22, 43.

persons.name: Usama bin Ladin
persons.role: Financier and mujahedin organizer during the Afghan war; later the subject of the report

mentions.quote: DURING THE AFGHAN WAR, USAMA BIN LADIN MET 'ABDALLAH AZZAM, WHO INFLUENCED HIM (BIN LADIN) TO ESTABLISH A NETWORK
SHORTLY THEREAFTER, BIN LADIN JOINED AZZAM IN PESRAWAR AND THEY FORMED THE

persons.name: Abdallah Azzam
persons.role: Mujahedin ideologue and organizer who influenced bin Ladin and co-formed the al-Khidmat organization in Peshawar

mentions.quote: BIN LADIN MET 'ABDALLAH AZZAM, WHO INFLUENCED HIM (BIN LADIN) TO ESTABLISH A NETWORK

persons.name: Usama Asmarai
persons.role: Associate of Ramzi Yousef; involved in the January 1995 Philippines airliner bombing plot; described in the summary as a Saudi national
persons.status_detail: Stated to be in U.S. custody as of April 1997

mentions.quote: (ASMARAI)), AKA WALI KHAN AMIN SHAH, A SAUDI NATIONAL
USAMA ASMARAI IS CURRENTLY IN U.S. CUSTODY.

persons.name: Ramzi Ahmed Yousef
persons.role: Plotter of the January 1995 plan in the Philippines to bomb U.S. airliners

mentions.quote: ASSOCIATE OF RAMZI AHMED ((YOUSEF)), WHO WAS INVOLVED WITH YOUSEF IN THE JANUARY 1995 PLOT IN THE PHILIPPINES

organizations.name: Maktab al-Khidmat
organizations.notes: The text is partly illegible; the name is inferred from 'L-KHIDMAT' and 'MK)'. It was formed by Azzam and bin Ladin in Peshawar.

places.name: Peshawar
places.significance: Bin Ladin joined Azzam here and they formed the al-Khidmat organization.

places.name: Afghanistan
places.significance: Setting of the Afghan war, during which bin Ladin met Azzam.

places.name: Philippines
places.significance: Location of the January 1995 plot to bomb U.S. airliners.

events.description: During the Afghan war, bin Ladin met Abdallah Azzam, who influenced him to establish a network supporting mujahedin recruitment and fundraising.
Bin Ladin joined Azzam in Peshawar and they formed al-Khidmat (Maktab al-Khidmat).
Plot in the Philippines to bomb U.S. airliners, involving Ramzi Yousef and an associate (Asmarai/Wali Khan Amin Shah).
CIA information report on bin Ladin's historical links to Azzam.
During the Afghan War bin Ladin met Abdallah Azzam, who influenced him to establish a network for recruitment and funding.
Bin Ladin joined Azzam in Peshawar and they formed Maktab al-Khidmat.
Plot in the Philippines by Yousef and Asmarai to bomb U.S. airliners.
CIA information report on bin Ladin's historical links to Azzam is issued.

key_claims: Abdallah Azzam influenced Usama bin Ladin to establish a network enhancing mujahedin abilities to recruit fighters and obtain contributions from around the Islamic world.
Bin Ladin joined Azzam in Peshawar, where they formed the al-Khidmat organization (partly illegible in the source).
Usama Asmarai, aka Wali Khan Amin Shah, was an associate of Ramzi Yousef in the January 1995 Philippines plot to bomb U.S. airliners and is in U.S. custody.
